title: Constant generic rank affine module becomes free on blowup charts
statement: Let $R\to B$ be a flat homomorphism of commutative rings of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map, def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Assume that for every prime $\mathfrak p\subset R$ and every field extension $K/\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, the ring $B\otimes_R K$ is an integral domain. Let $h\in R$, let $r\geq0$ be an integer, and let $N$ be a finitely generated $B$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] with $N_h$ finitely presented over $B_h$ [def-sc-finitely-presented-module, def-weil-pbc-module-localization]. For a prime $\mathfrak p\subset R$, let $\mathfrak q_{\mathfrak p}$ be the inverse image of the zero prime of $B\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, where residue fields and spectra are as in [def-weil-residue-field, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Assume $N_{\mathfrak q_{\mathfrak p}}\cong B_{\mathfrak q_{\mathfrak p}}^{\oplus r}$ whenever $h\notin\mathfrak p$ [def-weil-pbc-free-module]. Then there is a finitely generated ideal $I\subset R$ with $V(I)=V(h)$ such that the following holds for every $a\in I$. Put $R_a^I=R[I/a]\subset R[1/a]$, the subring generated by the image of $R$ and all $i/a$ for $i\in I$, put $B_a^I=B\otimes_R R_a^I$, and put $N_a^I=(N\otimes_R R_a^I)/T_a$, where $T_a=\{m\mid a^n m=0\text{ for some }n\geq0\}$. For every prime $\mathfrak p^{\prime}\subset R_a^I$, there is $g\in B_a^I$ whose image in $B_a^I\otimes_{R_a^I}\kappa(\mathfrak p^{\prime})$ is nonzero and for which $(N_a^I)_g\cong((B_a^I)_g)^{\oplus r}$.

source.place: Tag 0810, lemma-helper-blowup-affine-space. Here the prime is written explicitly as the inverse image of the generic fibre prime.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-affine-fp-approximation-strict-transform] to $N$ and the image of $h$ in $B$. Obtain a finitely presented $M\twoheadrightarrow N$ with $M_h\cong N_h$. It has the same rank-$r$ fibre-generic stalks over $R_h$, since $h$ is invertible at each such stalk. Retain the lemma's comparison of power-torsion quotients for the final transfer.

source.place: Tag 0810, lemma-helper-blowup-affine-space, first proof paragraph: finite-presentation replacement and comparison of the two power-torsion quotients.

proof.text: By [lem-trf-affine-geometrically-integral-projective], choose a split embedding $i:B\to\bigoplus_\alpha R$ and retraction $\rho$. Apply [lem-trf-affine-generic-rank-coefficient-ideal] to $M$: for $J=\operatorname{Fit}_r(M)$ choose its finite generators and their coordinate ideal $C$. It supplies the finitely generated $I=hC$ with $V(I)=V(h)$, and, when $r>0$, $\operatorname{Fit}_{r-1}(M)B_h=0$.

source.place: Tag 0810, lemma-helper-blowup-affine-space, coefficient-ideal paragraph, V(f)=V(I) paragraph, and last paragraph detecting lower-Fitting vanishing on the original principal open.

proof.text: Fix $a\in I$, write $a=hc$ with $c\in C$, and put $R^*=R[I/a]$, $B^*=B\otimes_RR^*$. Apply [lem-trf-affine-split-coefficient-chart-principal] to the split embedding and the generators of $J$. It gives regularity of $a$ on $B^*$, the fibre-domain injection, and, for every base prime $\mathfrak p^*$, the prime $\mathfrak q^*=\mathfrak p^*B^*$ with $JB^*_{\mathfrak q^*}=cB^*_{\mathfrak q^*}$. It also identifies $(R^*)_a=R_a$, where $h^{-1}=c/a$. If $R^*=0$, it has no prime and the chart assertion is vacuous.

source.place: Tag 0810, lemma-helper-blowup-affine-space, chart paragraph beginning Let a in I: principalization and division of split coordinates; corrected fibrewise form of the divided-generator assertion.

proof.text: Put $P=M\otimes_RR^*$. Fitting base change [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change] gives $\operatorname{Fit}_r(P_{\mathfrak q^*})=(c)$. If $r>0$, it also gives $\operatorname{Fit}_{r-1}(P_a)=0$: by step 3 the map $B\to B^*_a$ factors through $B_h$, where step 2 gives vanishing. Apply [lem-trf-principal-fitting-power-torsion-free-open] with $A=B^*$ and the images of $a,h,c$ (so $a=hc$ in $A$) to obtain $g\notin\mathfrak q^*$ and $(P/\Gamma_{(a)}P)_g\cong(B^*_g)^{\oplus r}$. Apply the comparison in step 1 with $D=B^*$ and $a=hc$ to identify this quotient with $N_a^I$; tensor associativity identifies scalar extension from $B$ with $N\otimes_RR^*$. Finally the injection in step 3 makes the fibre image of $g$ nonzero. This proves the assertion for every $a$ and every base prime, including $r=0$.

source.place: Tag 0810, lemma-helper-blowup-affine-space, last two proof paragraphs: principal Fitting generators, spreading generators and vanishing of relations; abstracted to an arbitrary ring and prime.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0810, lemma-helper-blowup-affine-space; assembly of four independent extracted arguments, retaining the corrected chart localization and divided-coordinate interpretation.
